title: Splicing hashtags
goal: Combine the fixed brackets and the incoming topic text into a string.
summary: Write fixed text in quotation marks. + Multiple strings can be concatenated in sequence, and the original characters will be retained during splicing.
tasks: uses + inside the curly brackets of labelTopic to connect "[", the parameter topic and "]".
Use return to return the assembled string. The characters, spaces, and leading zeros of the original topic are retained, and the empty string is "[]".
hint: The brackets are fixed text and must be enclosed in quotation marks. When reading the actual content in the parameter, write topic directly.

example.code:
const extension = '204';
const phone = 'Training room extension ' + extension;
example.note: Address Book puts the fixed prompt and extension number together to get "Training room extension 204".
